citations.evidenceText: Summary • AI ≠ one thing AI is a diverse field: ML, DL, CV, NLP, Planning, Robotics working together • Data is foundation ML systems learn from data — quality and quantity both matter enormously • Perception first Robots must perceive before they can act — CNNs, LiDARs, sensor fusion • Uncertainty is real Probabilistic methods (Kalman, Bayes, RL) handle the uncertain real world • End-to-end learning Deep RL and IL learn complex behaviours directly from sensors to motors Vision-Language Model (VLMs) and Large Language Model (LLMs) are • Foundation era revolutionising robot generalisation — language grounded action Robustness, alignment and ethics are not optional — they are engineering • Safety matters requirements "Machines without emotion may never be truly intelligent." — Marvin Minsky 44
